name: B10-0087/2026 (Renew) – Presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the presidential election in Honduras. It says the result, which made Nasry Asfura president-elect, reflects the will of the voters. It calls on the current government to accept that result and allow a peaceful handover of power. It also condemns an attack on an opposition politician, Gladys Aurora Lopez, and asks the authorities to investigate it and protect elected members.

- **What changes:** Nothing in law. Parliament only states its opinion and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** Honduras's current government, its electoral council, and elected politicians including opposition members.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission and the Honduran government and congress.
